table.claim_it_supports: LLM edit-sequence prediction rescues ~28.4% (P2M) / 29.1% (ResGen) at similarity>0.6 with Gemini-2.5-Pro; sets the synthesis-rescue baseline the ontology arm must beat.
table.experiment_it_motivates: Head-to-head end2edit validity + hardOK benchmark against the syncraft arm.

table.claim_it_supports: Agents do engineering but fail at evidence sufficiency.
table.experiment_it_motivates: Evidence-sufficiency audit: require each proposed edit to be backed by an ontology inference rather than an agent assertion.

table.claim_it_supports: These protein structures define the crossdocked binding context against which binding interactions must be preserved during editing.
table.experiment_it_motivates: Crossdock re-scoring / binding-interaction preservation across the 7 PDB targets.

table.claim_it_supports: Ontology reasoner materializes required operations (A21 hasRequiredOperation SET_CHIRAL=115), failure risks (A19 hasFailureRisk=231), protected atoms (A20 hasProtectedAtom=363), ValidatedEditSequence=78, StereocenterPreservingReaction=2, StereocenterAnchor 契约=320 — localizing where/why a structure is problematic and what must not change.
table.experiment_it_motivates: Reasoner-driven edit validation: reject edits violating ProtectedAtom/StereocenterAnchor, require SET_CHIRAL where inferred, accept only ValidatedEditSequence instances.

retrieval_plan.wave_1_competitor_baseline: Retrieve the strongest published synthesizability-editing method to fix the comparison bar.
retrieval_plan.wave_2_methodological_guardrail: Retrieve evidence on agent failure modes to justify ontology grounding over free-form agent claims.
retrieval_plan.wave_3_structural_binding_evidence: Retrieve the protein targets that define the binding-interaction constraints edits must preserve.
retrieval_plan.wave_4_internal_ontology_evidence: Retrieve reasoner-materialized axioms that localize the defect and constrain edits.
retrieval_plan.wave_5_quantitative_arm_outcomes: Retrieve the arm-level metrics that decide whether the survivor holds.
